      org.opencontainers.image.source="https://github.com/quillstack/quill-render" \
      org.opencontainers.image.authors="⟦name|Deshawn Price⟧ <⟦email address|dprice@quillstack.io⟧>" \
      maintainer="⟦name|Deshawn Price⟧"

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 \
    APP_HOME=/srv/quill

RUN groupadd --system --gid 10001 quill \
 && useradd --system --uid 10001 --gid quill --home-dir /srv/quill quill \
 && apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libpango-1.0-0 libpangoft2-1.0-0 fontconfig \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

FROM base AS build
WORKDIR /build
COPY pyproject.toml poetry.lock ./
RUN pip install poetry==1.8.3 && poetry export -f requirements.txt -o requirements.txt --without dev
RUN pip wheel --wheel-dir /wheels -r requirements.txt

FROM base AS runtime
WORKDIR ${APP_HOME}
COPY --from=build /wheels /wheels
RUN pip install /wheels/* && rm -rf /wheels

USER quill
EXPOSE 8000

### Added
- `--since` flag for `tally export`, accepting ISO-8601 or relative values like `7d` (#1452, thanks ⟦username|@renata-sz⟧)

- Bumped `sqlite3` 5.1.6 -> 5.1.7, `yargs` 17.7.2 -> 18.0.0

### Security
- CVE-2026-31337: path traversal in `tally import` when given a crafted ZIP. Credit to ⟦name|Alejandro Ibarra-Soto⟧ for responsible disclosure.

## [5.1.3] - 2026-08-29

### Fixed
- Rounding of amounts like 1,234.565 in CSV export (#1431)
- `tally doctor` now detects stale lockfiles in `~/.tally/locks` (#1429)
